proposals.action_title: Publish First KDP Coloring Book via Runware/Together AI
proposals.why_this_works_now: The coloring book pipeline is already built but stalled on image generation. Using the 20 EUR budget on Runware PAYG (or Together AI's free tier) unblocks high-quality image generation immediately. Publishing a 40-page book triggers organic Amazon search placement within 72 hours without ad spend.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure the TOGETHER_API_KEY in GitHub Actions secrets, run the 'produce_coloring_book' workflow, and download the finished PDF package directly to your Android device.

proposals.action_title: Cross-sell KDP Coloring Book PDF on Gumroad/Ko-fi via Pinterest
proposals.why_this_works_now: Amazon KDP takes up to 72 hours to approve and weeks to index. By putting the exact same coloring book PDF on a free Ko-fi/Gumroad store as a printable digital download, you can immediately drive direct traffic. Free Pinterest pins can be auto-generated to showcase the coloring pages.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a free Ko-fi account on your mobile browser, upload the generated coloring book PDF, and set the price to 3.99 EUR.

proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Text-Only & Simple Vector PNGs to Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Text-only and simple vector designs do not require complex AI image generation, avoiding the current image gen bottleneck completely. They sell well on stickers and mugs. Generating transparent PNG text designs via Termux (using Python's Pillow library) allows bulk creation on mobile.
proposals.first_action_today: Run a simple Termux Python script using Pillow to generate 20 funny/relatable text-based PNG designs for specific niches (e.g., developers, hobbyists) and upload them manually to Redbubble.

proposals.action_title: Launch 3 Parametric 3D Utility Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D has a highly active user base looking for functional, low-plastic utility prints (like custom brackets, SD card holders, or phone stands). You can generate these STL files using OpenSCAD command-line scripts run directly inside Termux or GitHub Actions, requiring zero 3D modeling software on a PC.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a basic parametric OpenSCAD script for a modular drawer organizer, compile the STL on Termux, and list it on Cults3D for 1.50 EUR.

proposals.action_title: Package and Publish 2D Retro Game Asset Packs on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly buy cheap assets. By using Pollinations (which is operational) or Together AI with pixel-art prompts, you can generate sprite sheets, seamless textures, or UI buttons. Packaging them into a zip file on GitHub Actions and uploading to itch.io targets a high-conversion micro-market.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a set of 16x16 pixel art RPG items using Together AI (FLUX-schnell), assemble them into a single grid sheet via Python, and upload to itch.io for 2.00 USD.
